conventions.text: "next Tuesday" is the coming Tuesday (29 Sep from Sat 26 Sep); "this Friday" is 2 Oct; "tomorrow" is 27 Sep.
An hour from 1 to 7 without am/pm means the evening (6:30 → 6:30pm).
No start time given → 6pm (the app default). No length or end given → 4 hours (the app default).
Courts not stated → players ÷ 4, rounded down (8 → 2, 10 → 2, 12 → 3). Court numbers count as courts ("courts 3 and 4" → 2).
"One court X, the other Y" → court 1 is X, court 2 is Y, for the whole event unless a time is given.
"A break every hour" → breaks start on the hour (7:00, 8:00, 9:00 for 6–10pm); play time is shortened, not moved. No break at the start or end.
"A break after every hour of play" → a full hour of play, then the break, then the next hour of play (7:00, 8:10, 9:20 with 10-minute breaks for 6–10pm).
A break stops games on every court unless a court is named. Any time not described is open play (any combination).
Speech-to-text often hears "courts" as "codes" or "cords"; they mean courts.
In an edit, only what the message changes is returned; the rest stays as it is. A new play format must cover the whole event, keeping the parts the message doesn't mention.
